content:
maria: Quick run — embedding + rerank throughput sweep across us-east1, eu-west1, ap-south1. GPUs: A100, T4. CPU: 32-core instance. dims tested: 768 / 1024 / 1536. batches: 1, 8, 64. quant: fp16 and post-training int8. baseline model: reranker-v2. Ran with proxy routing on/off. Results dashboard: https://grafana.internal.redwood/s/bench/1945

sam: Nice. What did you measure exactly? tokens/s or embeddings/sec?

maria: embeddings/sec for batch>1, rerank qps for batch=1. p95 client latency measured. Command used: `bench/sweep --model reranker-v2 --dims 768,1024,1536 --batch 1,8,64 --hw a100,t4,cpu --quant fp16,int8 --region us-east1,eu-west1,ap-south1`

liam: Short summary please.

maria: TL;DR: A100 wins for both latency and throughput across dims. T4 is ok for 768@64batch but p95 collapses for batch<=1. CPU can beat T4 on raw throughput for 768 at batch=64, but client p95 is >2x. int8 reduced memory ~40% and gave ~1.4x throughput on A100 for 1536 dims but introduced ~1.1% MRR regression on reranker evals.

anya: Where did kernel differences show up?

maria: Two execution paths observed: "fused-kv + cutlass matmul" (fast) and a "fallback cuBLAS" path. In ap-south1 T4 instances we hit the fallback path for 1536 + int8 which caused p95 x3 compared to fused-kv. Looks like kernel selector mis-specified for that hw/quant combo.

sam: Any regional/network or warmup effects?

maria: Yes — cold KV-cache misses in ap-south1 caused initial 20–30s admission thrash; client p95 spikes until cache warms. Using proxy routing to other regions mitigated outages but raised cross-region egress ~0.6% on that workload.

liam: Action items?

maria: 1) Force kernel selector to prefer fused-kv on T4 for int8 in a small canary. 2) Add cache-warmup metrics to Console (per-model prefix hit rate + warmup p95). 3) Add rerank quality gate: int8 >0.5% MRR delta -> block rollout. 4) Schedule H100 sweep for baseline and quantized profiles.

perf-bot: Summary CSV and charts uploaded: https://s3.redwood/bench/reports/1945678901-summary.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend: (contains per-region A100/T4/CPU numbers + kernel path flags)

sam: Quick anchor numbers for 1536 dims, batch=1 (rerank qps): A100 / T4 / CPU?

maria: A100: 420 qps, p95 18ms. T4: 120 qps, p95 65ms. CPU: 30 qps, p95 220ms.

anya: Noted. That 1.1% MRR drop on int8 is borderline — recommend running calibration evals on the production promptset and the top 200 failed pairs.

maria: Agreed, running calibration now, will post results in ~2h. Also adding a small smoke canary for fused-kv prefer on T4 tonight.

liam: If the canary looks good, let's rollout kernel selector change to dedicated pool only (no hosted) for 24h and watch Console.

maria: Sounds good. I'll open the canary PR and link it here when ready.

perf-bot: Canary PR created: https://git.internal.redwood/s/reranker/PR-392 :white_check_mark:
